name: Famine
value: Risk of famine: Sudan, South Sudan
summary: FEWS NET sees risk of Famine in Darfur, South Kordofan and South Sudan; no new Famine classification found as of 8 Nov
state: FEWS NET's update for September 2026 to January 2027 says the risk of Famine has expanded to Sharg Aj-Jabal in South Darfur and persists in parts of North Darfur and South Kordofan. Acute malnutrition passed the Famine threshold in two of four assessed camps, which FEWS NET says does not establish Famine. It also sees a credible risk of Famine in Akobo, Nyirol, Ulang and Nasir in South Sudan through January 2027. Searches on 8 Nov found no new IPC Famine classification.
for_you: Displaced families in Darfur, South Kordofan and northern South Sudan are most exposed. Further fighting, drought or aid access limits are what FEWS NET says could push these areas into Famine.
rubric_hit: Watch: risk of Famine (IPC Phase 5) alerts from FEWS NET for Sudan and South Sudan. Alert line not met: no Famine confirmed in any area as of 8 Nov.

sources.title: FEWS NET — As drought compounds conflict, the risk of Famine expands to parts of South Darfur

why: Famine is the most extreme humanitarian failure, almost always man-made by conflict.
drivers: War, sieges, aid access, harvest failure, funding cuts.

rubric.alert: Famine (IPC Phase 5) confirmed in at least one area.

rubric.normal: No IPC Phase 5 (Famine) classifications or projections.
